tools.name: status
tools.description: Show this worktree's iOS simulator: its device id, whether it is booted, and its screen size in points. Each worktree has its own device on its worker (a Mac). The device boots on the first screenshot, tap or other action.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of this worktree's iOS simulator, booting it first when it is off. Answers with the image and a line with its pixel size and the scale. Coordinates for simulator_tap are in points: pixels divided by scale.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: Read the iOS simulator screen's accessibility tree: each element's type, label, value and id, its frame and the point to tap it at. Cheaper and more exact than reading a screenshot. Coordinates are in points.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap the iOS simulator screen. Coordinates are in points, not screenshot pixels: divide pixels by the scale that simulator_screenshot reports (3 on current iPhones).

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field of the iOS simulator.

tools.name: button
tools.description: Press a hardware button on the iOS simulator.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in the iOS simulator. A web URL opens Safari, a custom scheme opens the app that registered it.

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install an .app folder from this worktree (a simulator build) on the iOS simulator.

path.description: Absolute path of the .app inside this worktree

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch an installed app on the iOS simulator by bundle id.
